runtime_settings: wandb.entity=novphy (required by main.py; unused when disabled)
lightning.seed_everything(seed) before main (upstream sets no seed)
precision: official 16-mixed on a GPU; fp32 on a CPU (Lightning has no CPU fp16-mixed)

decision: Decision P-fid on #136 (posted with this file's sha256)
experiment: multivariate probabilistic time-series forecasting, Exchange (GluonTS exchange_rate_nips: 8 series, business-day, context = prediction = 30)
metric: test CRPS-sum (official crps_quantile_sum: 19 quantiles of 100 sampled paths, summed over the 8 series), printed as test/crps_sum by the official test task on the best (validation CRPS-sum) checkpoint
paper: Chen et al., Diffusion Forcing: Next-token Prediction Meets Full-Sequence Diffusion (NeurIPS 2024, arXiv 2407.01392), Table 2
repairs: at most two logged repair attempts, each fixing a diagnosed port / environment defect, never the band; then fidelity_not_reproduced
rule: pass iff low <= crps_sum < high (our value rounded to the paper's 3 decimals lies in the paper's mean ± 2 SD, [0.001, 0.005])
